anchor: OWHS v0.1; sustained-return status at a checkpoint (no UK incumbent)
notes: Promoted from an inline enum in ReturnToWorkOutcome at v0.1; the values are unchanged, so no instance that was valid before is invalid now. Closed vocabulary: the schema pins it by name@version and a producer may not extend it. `unknown` is retained deliberately, because a checkpoint that was not followed up is a different fact from a relapse and collapsing the two would overstate sustained returns. whiu: crosswalk reserved.

values.label: Still in work at the checkpoint
Absent again at the checkpoint for the same or a related reason
Checkpoint not followed up, or status not recorded
values.note: not a relapse; distinguishes missing follow-up from a known outcome
